root_cause.text: The sysfs attribute show/store functions for isolate_strategy (isolate_strategy_show and isolate_strategy_store) did not check whether the corresponding callback (isolate_err_threshold_read or isolate_err_threshold_write) existed before dereferencing it, causing a NULL pointer dereference when only one of the two callbacks was implemented.
